integrity: Proof and symbolic checks are provided; no experimental evidence is promoted to an infinite-iteration argument or independent certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact necessary-and-sufficient asymptotic stability is confined to equal-diagonal two-coordinate SPD quadratics with cyclic one-coordinate CoCD, exact central differences, fixed positive stepsize, and buffer-decay parameter between zero and one. It does not imply per-step descent or nonlinear/global dimension-free guarantees. Prior work on periodically switched stale-gradient methods leaves residual originality risk; external verification has not been undertaken.
title: Sharp fading-memory stability for two-coordinate Coherent Coordinate Descent
